neighbours.label: the letter string 'act'/'akt' inside a word, strongest in tr-act words (Traktor, tracts, tractor, detractors, distraction)
fire: On weekends my cousin plays house music using Traktor on an old laptop.
In the barn there was a rusty red tractor that nobody had driven in years.
The church printed thousands of small tracts and gave them away for free.
Even his loudest detractors admitted that the bridge was built on time.
For many drivers the phone is the most dangerous distraction on the road.
Wild elephants are the main attraction for visitors to the national park.
Two young actors from the village were cast in the new television drama.
These simple acts of courage were remembered by the town for decades.
